subject: Northward onboarding: on-prem integration cadence & networking checklist
messages:
From: Anna Patel <anna@northward.health>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: Victor Ramos <victor.ramos@northward.health>
Date: Tue, 19 Jun 2028 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private deploy next steps — network info and timeline

Hi Kimberly —

Thanks again for yesterday's demo. We're ready to start the integration planning for a private on‑prem package + VPC peering. To get us moving I attached our basic network inventory. Please confirm whether this level of detail is sufficient and what else you need from our side to scope the on‑prem bundle.

High-level asks from our infra team:
- Expected ingress IP ranges and egress destinations for outbound model calls
- Firewall / proxy rules for the appliance management plane
- Whether Redwood requires outbound TLS termination or supports passthrough
- Any HSM/KMS network considerations for key sync

Can we schedule a 60‑minute technical kickoff this week (preferred Wed/Thu morning PT)?

Thanks,
Anna Patel
Director, Cloud Ops — Northward Health

Attachment: northward-network-inventory-v1.xlsx (spreadsheet stub, 42KB)
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Anna Patel <anna@northward.health>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 19 Jun 2028 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Private deploy next steps — network info and timeline

Hi Anna —

Got the inventory, thank you — this is a great start. Quick answers up front:
- We'll provide both the appliance egress ranges (for model telemetry and license checks) and the management plane IPs; expect a short list of CIDR blocks by EOD tomorrow.
- Redwood appliance supports TLS passthrough for customer PKI, but we also offer optional TLS termination for customers that want Redwood-managed certs. We'll note the preference on the MAP.
- For KMS/HSM we recommend a dedicated management VPC endpoint; details below in the MAP doc.

I've looped in Marissa (customer success lead) and Grace (solutions engineering) to own the kickoff and runbook respectively. Proposed cadence:
1) Technical kickoff (60m) — deep dive on inventory, firewall and proxy constraints, and cert workflow
2) Network dry‑run — validate peering and BGP (if applicable) in staging environment
3) On‑prem appliance install (2 days on site) + post‑install validation
4) Cutover and acceptance tests (smoke tests for latency, throughput, and auth)

Marissa — can you propose Wed/Thu windows? Grace/Jordan, Marissa and I will sync on the runbook template I sent earlier (linked).

Best,
Kimberly Park
Senior Solutions Manager — Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood-private-onprem-checklist.pdf (checklist stub, 18KB)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Anna Patel <anna@northward.health>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 20 Jun 2028 09:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Private deploy next steps — network info and timeline

Thanks Anna — Wed 21 Jun at 09:30 PT or Thu 22 Jun at 10:00 PT both work on our side. I'll block Wed 09:30 PT for the kickoff and send a calendar invite with a short agenda.

Prep for the kickoff (please bring or drop in the Drive link):
- Confirm NAT and egress expectations for any outbound telemetry; list of proxy FQDNs if traffic goes through a corporate proxy
- If you use split DNS for service endpoints, include the internal names + expected TTLs
- Any compliance constraints on data at rest for the appliance (we have a separate HSM checklist if needed)

I attached a draft mutual action plan (MAP) that maps owners and deadlines — fill the yellow fields before kickoff if possible.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager — Redwood Inference

Attachment: mutual-action-plan-northward.docx (document stub, 26KB)
From: Anna Patel <anna@northward.health>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: Victor Ramos <victor.ramos@northward.health>
Date: Thu, 21 Jun 2028 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Private deploy next steps — network info and timeline

Marissa / Kimberly —

Thanks — Wed 21 Jun 09:30 PT confirmed. I uploaded a short proxy config extract and our split DNS table to the Drive link and populated the owner fields in the MAP. Two quick clarifying questions before the kickoff:
1) For the appliance management plane, do you require inbound access from Redwood IPs or will you poll outbound only?
2) For the HSM key sync, are STS tokens sufficient or do you need a long‑lived service account?

Victor (cc) will join the kickoff and can speak to firewall policy.

Appreciate the quick turnaround,
Anna

Drive: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2B3cNorthwardOnpremPlaybook
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Anna Patel <anna@northward.health>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 22 Jun 2028 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Northward onboarding: on-prem integration cadence & networking checklist

Hi team —

Quick answers for the kickoff so Victor's team has context:
- Management plane: Redwood will prefer outbound pull (appliance polls our management control plane over TLS) — no inbound open ports required by default. If you have legacy requirements, we can support inbound with a narrow CIDR allowlist.
- HSM key sync: STS tokens are fine for initial sync; for long‑term we recommend a short‑lived cert exchange + rotating service principal. I'll bring the HSM pattern details to the kickoff and a short sequence diagram.

I'll also bring the runbook checklist and a sample fw rule set (for the staging dry‑run). See you Wed 09:30 PT.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Senior Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference
